The space
After a fun-filled day exploring Nashville, unwind in one of our three spacious bedrooms—each designed as a peaceful haven for rest and relaxation. This home was crafted with good vibes and great memories in mind, combining comfort, style, and a playful touch throughout.

You’ll enjoy quick and easy access to Nashville’s top attractions, plus the convenience of garage parking and smooth rides via Uber, Lyft, or taxi. The airport is just 15 minutes away, making arrival and departure a breeze.

Whether you're here to celebrate, explore, or simply soak in the city's energy, this home is your perfect launchpad for experiencing all that Music City has to offer. Come stay, make memories, and feel right at home in Nashville!

Welcome to Bach Nashville, a pink girls’ getaway just 10 minutes from Broadway. Perfect for bachelorette weekends, girls’ trips, and group stays in Nashville. Enjoy themed Taylor Swift and Dolly Parton bedrooms, stylish photo-ready spaces, and a fun, memorable atmosphere. Close to downtown dining, music, and nightlife, this home is designed for unforgettable group trips and celebrating your time in Music City with friends.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to the entire home, including all bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, and living areas. Free parking is available in the 2-car garage.

Check-in is seamless with keypad, so you can arrive at your convenience.

During your stay, you’ll have everything you need for a comfortable visit, including high-speed Wi-Fi, streaming TV, and a fully equipped kitchen.

Other things to note
Quiet hours are from 10 PM–8 AM in respect to neighbors.

Absolutely no parties or unauthorized guests are allowed.

Parking details: Free parking in our 2-car garage

The home is professionally cleaned between each stay for your comfort.

Nashville has rideshare options (Uber/Lyft) everywhere, so getting downtown or to Broadway is quick and easy.

Please note: This is a 3-Story townhouse
